تواثبت (form VI)
# تَوَاثَبْتُ (tawāṯabtu) /ta.waː.θab.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَوَاثَبَ (tawāṯaba)
# تَوَاثَبْتَ (tawāṯabta) /ta.waː.θab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَوَاثَبَ (tawāṯaba)
# تَوَاثَبْتِ (tawāṯabti) /ta.waː.θab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَوَاثَبَ (tawāṯaba)
# تَوَاثَبَتْ (tawāṯabat) /ta.waː.θa.bat/: third-person fem
